# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_BEAR_UPTO20

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Relaxing the BEAR-side VIX filter from VIX ≤ 18 to VIX ≤ 20 will increase entry frequency on moderately elevated VIX days without significantly degrading win rate, because VIX up to 20 still reflects elevated fear environment conducive to bearish continuation setups. This may capture additional BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON opportunities that were previously filtered out.

## Mechanism

Modify the VIX condition in the BEAR entry path (e.g., in `v14_enhanced_watcher.py` or equivalent filter) to allow entries when VIX ≤ 20 (instead of ≤ 18). All other trigger components (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence, time of day, etc.) remain unchanged. Exit logic (chart stop, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop, time stop) stays identical.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ≈ 14% of headline P&L (per OP-20 guideline).
2. **Sample bias:** No historical backtest performed; proposal based solely on today's intraday observation. High overfit risk if generalized without OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out test conducted).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic OPRA simulation on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: entering on VIX 19-20 during a false breakdown could increase losses if the filter admits low-quality setups.
   - Max drawdown: potential increase if additional entries cluster on losing days.
   - Blow-up scenario: VIX spikes >20 after entry (e.g., volatility crush) combined with adverse SPY move could trigger catastrophic stops on multiple contracts.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown; requires backtest to determine if top-5 days would shift proportion of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

- Pass gym validators for modified filter logic.

- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) showing <±20% P&L deviation vs. BS-sim.
- Stage-1 backtest confirming no regression on anchor days (edge_capture ≥ 0 on each J winner, ≤ current loss on J losers).
